course.title: Certified Internal Auditor Training on ISO 42001 (AIMS)
course.short_introduction: At Quality Asia School, we are committed to providing comprehensive training, free of cost, to help you become a Certified Internal Auditor for ISO 42001. This course is designed to offer you the essential knowledge and skills needed to conduct effective internal audits.
course.description:
Course Outline

  • Access to Training Videos: Begin your journey by watching our detailed training videos that cover all the essential topics and requirements of ISO 42001.

  • Downloadable PDF Content: Supplement your learning with downloadable PDF materials, including guidelines, checklists, and best practices.

Course Flow

  1. Attempt the Final Exam: Once you have completed the video sessions and reviewed the PDF materials, you will be ready to attempt the final exam. The exam link will be provided through a Google Form.

  2. Qualification Criteria: To qualify, you must score 70% or above. If successful, you will receive a certificate of completion.

  3. Certification: Receive Your Training Certificate: Upon qualification, your Training Certificate will be generated and emailed to you at the address provided during Training Exam.

  4. Support: If you have any questions during your training, feel free to raise them in our course forum or write directly to us at trainings@qualityasia.in. Our team is here to support you every step of the way.

course.name: free-certified-internal-auditor-training-on-iso-27701-privacy-information-management-system
course.title: ISO 27701
course.short_introduction: FREE Certified Internal Auditor Training on ISO 27701 (Privacy Information Management System)
course.description:
At Quality Asia School, we are committed to providing comprehensive, free of cost training to help you become a Certified Internal Auditor for ISO 27701. This course is designed to equip you with essential knowledge and auditing skills aligned with privacy information management and data protection requirements.

Course Outline

  1. Access to Training Videos

    • Begin your learning journey with our detailed training videos covering the structure, principles, and requirements of ISO 27701, including its integration with ISO 27001.

  2. Downloadable PDF Content

    • Enhance your understanding with supplementary learning materials, including checklists, privacy controls, audit guidance, and practical implementation tools.

Course Flow

  1. Complete the Training

    • Watch the full video sessions and review the PDF materials at your own pace.

  2. Attempt the Final Exam

    • Once prepared, attempt the final exam using the Google Form link provided.

  3. Qualification Criteria

    • You must score 70% or above to successfully complete the course.

  4. Receive Your Certificate

    • Upon qualification, your Training Certificate will be automatically generated and can be downloadable via clicking on Get Certificate button.

Need Help?

If you have any queries or need support during your training, feel free to:

  1. Post your questions in the course forum, or

  2. Write to us directly at trainings@qualityasia.in

Our team is here to support you every step of the way in your journey to become an ISO 27701 Internal Auditor.
